grammar.label: first conditional
grammar.form: If + present simple, will + base verb
grammar.meaning: a likely future result of a possible condition

body.text: My laptop won't start. The screen is black.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: If you press this button for ten seconds, it usually opens.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Is the cable in the socket? If the battery is low, the screen stays black.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: You are right. The cable was under the table.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: There you are. Wait a minute and try again.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: If you want, I will install an app to make a backup.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Yes, please. I use this laptop for my work.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then you need a backup. If you lose it, you lose a year of work.
